However, the exile of Bavel alludes

is only for the good and the salvation of Yisrael,
as it was in the exile of Bavel:
הַתְחָלַת יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר (יְשַׁעְיָה מב, כא),
the beginning of "He will make the Torah great and glorious" (Yeshayah 42:21),
and Yisrael merited more in Bavel
than they had merited in the Land.
from our holy master, teacher and Rebbe,

that when they were exiled to Bavel,

that the Holy One, blessed be He, would make shine

And we find that in the days of Achashverosh,

out of love of the Holy One, blessed be He.
For the holding of the mountain over them at Sinai

they accepted upon themselves the Torah she'b'al peh

And the exile itself brought about for Yisrael
the spreading of the holy Torah,
"For in much wisdom is much anger" —
brings about the revelation of abundant wisdom,
And this is why it brings the verse
from the hand of all your enemies":
And through the words of Torah
even the "heart of the fool" is rectified,
for the Holy One, blessed be He.
And likewise the mitzvah of sukkah
when Yisrael's sins have been forgiven
and they become a new creation,
drawing close to the Holy One, blessed be He —
that the exile is in order to increase our holiness,
And the sukkah also shields us,
for it is the spreading of the shelter of peace,
